items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: He played clarinet and his brother played drums, Lloyd Scott, and he had Don Fry on piano.

ctx.x: Excuse me. Yeah, Truehart on guitar. But I don't know who the bass was at that time. And then

came Cecil Scott's orchestra. Cecil Scott originated in my hometown, Springfield, Ohio. He used to be just a trio. He played clarinet and his brother played drums, Lloyd Scott, and he had Don Fry on piano. They used to do little jobs around home, so finally they got the idea to have a big band.
So they got Bill Coleman and Frankie Newton for their --
